title: VAT: introducing a new zero rate on donated medicines
text:
This measure confirms the introduction of a zero rate for donations of medicines:

 • to the NHS

 • for use in clinical trials

 • for the continued treatment of a patient who benefitted from taking part in a clinical trial

 The zero rate also applies to medicines imported for these purposes.

 This measure has effect from 23 June 2026.
